verification: Runtime-registered both local suites through benchmark/__init__.py from local vla_safety_task_map.py; checked each returned task identity and each local BDDL and pruned_init file exists; recorded BDDL SHA-256 and parsed full native goal expression.
runtime_path_note: LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH in the installed RLinf environment points at a stale external install; registry validation used the local LIBERO-Safety source and file roots, without rewriting user config.

runtime_registration_check.method: Loaded local libero/libero/benchmark/__init__.py and vla_safety_task_map.py with a temporary LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH pointing to the local LIBERO-Safety assets/data; confirmed get_benchmark() registers both requested suites and returns 15 tasks per suite with {0:5,1:5,2:5}; resolved every runtime BDDL and .pruned_init path.

source_bundle_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of ordered UTF-8 lines: <relative_path> <SHA-256(file bytes)><LF>, in source_bundle_files order.

task_approach_clearance_gate_correction.behavior: task_approach_only no longer applies the Strict-10mm clearance to BDDL-forbidden objects; actual collision/penetration checks remain enabled.

native_transport_future_goal_reserve_cor.behavior: Future-object action reserves are capped to remaining horizon slack after the estimated current-goal route and required current-goal completion actions, preventing future-goal reserves from reducing current-goal transport budget to zero.

native_On_orientation_fallback.behavior: For additional objects placed with native On, preserve the live held-object orientation; use the completed sibling only for matching support height because BDDL On imposes no yaw constraint.

native_On_layout_diversification.behavior: For multi-object native On placement under legacy full-geometry RRT, keep the highest sibling-clearance candidate and choose the shorter-travel alternate among generated candidates within 30 mm of its estimated clearance.

native_On_route_record_bddl_hash_pass_th.behavior: Pass expected scene BDDL SHA-256 through both _native_place call paths into _native_place_single so an offline-feasible RRT route record can preserve its BDDL identity without a NameError.

native_goal_continuation_retry_slot_cap.behavior: The bounded maximum stage index equals twice the initial native-goal count plus one extra retry slot per previously discarded same-run attempt.

exact_static_installation_contact_except.runtime_guards: Exact model fingerprint, geom/body IDs and names, and joint-free ancestor chains are required; all other robot/scene collision checks remain active.

native_region_clearance_world_vertical_a.behavior: Compute target lowest collision-geometry offset in world-up orientation before combining it with world-space obstacle top heights, so inverted native-region local z cannot inflate the route height.

native_success_timestep_guard.behavior: Write native_task_success_timestep only when the final native task status has task_success=true and a valid nonnegative timestep.
native_success_timestep_guard.archived_dev05_report_note: dev05 remains unchanged and has native_task_success=false with the legacy erroneous timestep 364.
